props.name: SliderProps
rows: Formats the values. This will format both the labels and the tooltip.
Called when the user selects a value. The event `detail` contains the current `value`.
How big the step size is.
Hides the colored fill line, so only the handle is visible.
Show the tick marks along the slider line. Use with stepped sliders, except in extreme cases.
Whether or not the slider is disabled.
Labels shown between the minimum and maximum values.
Adds an `aria-label` to the native control. Use this if you don't have a visible label for this control.
Adds an aria-description for slider labels. Use when sliders have formatted reference values.
An object containing all the necessary localized strings required by the component. @i18n

Specifies if the control is read-only, which prevents the user from modifying the value, but does not prevent the value from being included in a form submission. A read-only control is still focusable.
An object containing CSS properties to customize the slider's visual appearance. Refer to the [style](/components/slider/?tabId=style) tab for more details. @awsuiSystem core
